notes:
**"Running" was a claim about a switch, not about the app.** A deployed rule runs on a timer inside the app. Close it, or let your phone freeze it, and the rule stops looking - while the screen still said Running and the trade list still said "no trades yet, the conditions have not happened". Those are two different sentences: one means it looked and found nothing, the other means nobody looked. The Live screen now says when the rule last actually looked, and past three minutes during market hours it says so in amber and names the cause.

**Three VWAPs, one name.** A rule saying "above VWAP" was measured against a line that was not the one drawn on your chart, and not the one a price alert on the same level used. The chart's own version never reset at a session boundary either, so on a multi-day chart the "session VWAP" was a running average of the whole window. All of them use one function now.

**The daily trade cap reset on your phone's date, not India's.** On a phone set to another timezone the trading day rolled mid-session, or never.

**The chart's private EMA and RSI are gone** - they were identical copies, and two copies of an indicator agree right up until one of them is corrected.
